answer: Each identity must plant one cedar on a distinct canyon ledge, fed with yarrow tonic: the k-th cedar needs k(k+1)/2 tonic doses, so fake k pays 1.5k(k+1) credits and each new clone costs more than the last. Ten fakes pay 660 credits; a hundred pay 515,100. Two cedars on one ledge choke each other and both die, so one ledge can never serve two identities.
